title: Musk Claims SpaceXAI Has Built the World's Strongest Training Cluster: Expand 10 Times Next Year, Target 10GW by End of 2027

content_html:
Elon Musk estimated at a SpaceX employee meeting that the power capacity of SpaceX AI (formerly xAI) data centers will increase by about seven times before the end of 2027, reaching 10GW. This means that this company, which is famous for rockets, is rapidly advancing its AI computing infrastructure at an almost exponential pace. Musk also claimed that SpaceX AI has already built the "strongest AI training cluster in the world" and plans to further expand the cluster size to about 10 times its current scale by the end of next year.

It should be clarified that GW (gigawatts) is a unit of power, with 1GW equaling 1 billion watts. It is used to describe the power supply capacity or rated power consumption of data centers, but power supply capacity does not equate to actual computing power. Systems such as cooling, lighting, power distribution, networking, storage, and servers all consume electricity, so 10GW more often represents the energy consumption ceiling of the infrastructure rather than pure computing output.

30-50 Dollars per Watt, Annual Revenue Targeting 500 Billion Dollars

Musk calculated the stakes of this computing power gamble: if each watt is worth about 30 to 50 dollars, and the 10GW AI computing power can be online by the end of next year, xAI could generate annual revenue of 300 billion to 500 billion dollars. At current exchange rates, this range is approximately 2.03 trillion to 3.38 trillion Chinese yuan, almost equivalent to the GDP of a medium-sized country.

The basis for achieving this goal is the existing layout: the two data centers of SpaceX AI located in Memphis and Southaven have a combined rated power consumption of 1.4GW, and are planned to increase to 10GW by the end of 2027, meaning a growth of about seven times within about one and a half years. This aligns with Musk's previous prediction that "about 99% of SpaceX's value will come from AI five years later." When the rocket business is overtaken by the wave of computing power, SpaceX has essentially transformed into an AI infrastructure company. However, the power consumption scale of 10GW will also bring enormous pressure on the power grid and carbon footprint, and the competition between computing expansion and energy constraints may be more decisive for the success or failure of this gamble than the model itself.

content_html_zh:
埃隆·马斯克在 SpaceX 员工会议上预计，到 2027 年底前，SpaceX AI（原 xAI）数据中心的电力容量将增加约 7 倍，达到 10GW。 这意味着这家以火箭闻名的公司正以近乎指数级的速度快速推进其人工智能计算基础设施。 马斯克还声称，SpaceX AI已经建成了“世界上最强的AI训练集群”，并计划在明年底前将集群规模进一步扩大至目前规模的10倍左右。

需要说明的是，GW（吉瓦）是功率单位，1GW等于10亿瓦。 用于描述数据中心的供电能力或额定功耗，但供电能力并不等于实际算力。 冷却、照明、配电、网络、存储和服务器等系统都会消耗电力，因此10GW更多时候代表的是基础设施的能耗上限，而不是纯粹的计算输出。

每瓦30-50美元，年收入目标5000亿美元

马斯克计算了这场算力赌博的赌注：如果每瓦大约价值30到50美元，并且明年底10GW的AI算力能够上线，xAI每年可以产生3000亿到5000亿美元的收入。 按目前汇率计算，这一区间约为2.03万亿元至3.38万亿元人民币，几乎相当于一个中等国家的GDP。

实现这一目标的基础是现有的布局：SpaceX AI位于孟菲斯和南山文的两个数据中心的额定功耗合计为1.4GW，计划到2027年底增加到10GW，意味着在大约一年半的时间里增长了大约七倍。 这与马斯克之前的预测相符，即“五年后 SpaceX 约 99% 的价值将来自人工智能”。 当火箭业务被算力浪潮超越时，SpaceX 本质上已转型为一家 AI 基础设施公司。 然而，10GW的用电规模也会给电网和碳足迹带来巨大的压力，而计算扩展和能源约束之间的竞争可能比模型本身更能决定这场赌博的成败。
